add.issue.name: A card shows no diff stat though its Code tab lists and draws the linked commit

edit.description.md:
Seen by jola on ZPH0BJS (Review, Default board), v1.15.1: Code tab shows "1 commit, 3 files" and draws the diff of 06d728838 (linked by subject prefix), but the card draws no diff bar in Wide or Dense.

Their GUI was read-only, Zoom scope, scrubber parked in the past, filters "Lines (linked)" / "Board (all)". Check whether the card and Code tab disagree on which commits count under time travel.

add.issue.comment.md:
Not a regression: the card hides its diff stat whenever the board is scrubbed (SwimlaneColumn.tsx:388, `live ? diffStats[ref] : null`, since bdaa4dd3), and "Read-only" in the header means scrubbing. The Code tab ignores the cut and lists every commit, so the two disagree while time travelling.

Live, the server's answer has ZPH0BJS = 1 commit, +11 −6 (probed against a clone of the repo), so the bar should return once the scrubber goes back to now.

Open question: should a scrubbed card show its commits up to the cut instead of nothing? That needs diff-stats:get to take the cut (getCommitTimeline already accepts `end`). Tagged human-input-needed.
add.issue.comment.author: 1PEPNS6X0H0WK9GR8XQKN8YQCY

add.issue.name: The time-travel needle survives a reload through the URL

edit.description.md: A reload drops the scrubber back to live. Encode the needle position in the URL so a reload, or a shared link, opens the board at the same moment.

Encode a parked needle in the URL, so a server restart, a new tab, or a shared link opens the board at the same moment.

Must hold:
- A parked needle round-trips: reload or open the link → same moment.
- A live needle stays live: the URL carries no position, and a reload keeps following now rather than freezing at the moment of the reload.
- Going live clears the position from the URL.

Already true without this: on the same running server a parked needle survives a plain reload, since the server holds it.

add.issue.name: Clicking the window funnel takes a parked board back to live

edit.description.md: The funnel (narrow board to timeline window) leaves a parked needle where it is. Clicking it should snap the board out of the historical state, back to live.

add.issue.comment.md: Filed by mistake: the funnel already takes a parked board back to live. What matters is that the URL needle (HWY3CDW) follows it there; covered on that ticket.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: a scrubbed board counts each ticket's commits up to the needle, on the card and in the Code tab (commit list, Stats, squashed diff). Bars from a later moment are never drawn; an earlier cut's stay while a forward step's answer lands. Folds in 4MWFD39. PR #509.

Must hold:
- A parked needle round-trips: reload or open the link → same moment.

- Anything that takes the board back to live clears the position from the URL: Now, and the window funnel, which already snaps a parked board out of the historical state.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: a parked needle is written as `?at=<ms>`; live leaves it off. History gains one entry per needle release; Back/Forward (POP) move the board, the board's own navigation never does. A new socket's first state re-reads the URL, so a restarted server is taken back to the moment. Note: restoring an old tab with `?at=` re-parks the shared board for every tab. PR #512.
